notes.title: Try the Demo!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

Thank you for following STROLL! It's been a while since I've made an actual update to the Steam page, so I figured now was the time.

Since this game is a part time project, and I only work on it in what sparetime I have, the progress is unfortunately going much slowly that I'd have liked. I hope to get more focus time on the project and really start pumping out updates on the regular.

[b]TRY THE ALPHA[/b]
So, no big announcements today. I have however been rebalancing and fixing errors to the alpha build though and would like to ask for your feedback! If you go to[url=https://strollplay.itch.io/prototype] https://strollplay.itch.io/prototype[/url], there's an early build available there. It features a test map, some enemies and weapons that are 99% working as intended.

I would love to hear your thoughts! You can either share them here, on the itch page, or via the in-game Bug Reporter - either way, I'd really appreciate some first thoughts, annoyances, ideas - whatever might come to mind.


Again, I thank you for following along and hope to have many more updates to share with you throughout the year. Stay tuned.

-Stig
